title: Madeira Sunset Times by Month: When to Watch the Sun Go Down at Sea
description: Madeira sunset times by month, from about 18:10 in December to 21:15 in June, plus when a private sunset boat trip leaves Funchal and what to bring.
heroAlt: Golden sunset light over the sea and cliffs on the south coast of Madeira

images.prompt: A wide landscape photograph of golden sunset light over the calm sea below the tall green basalt sea cliffs of Cabo Girão on Madeira's south coast, warm sky with soft clouds, shot from the water.
images.alt: Golden sunset light over the sea and cliffs on the south coast of Madeira

images.prompt: A small white private motorboat cruising on calm water at golden hour near Câmara de Lobos, Madeira, the fishing village and hillside glowing orange in the background.
images.alt: A small white motorboat at golden hour off Câmara de Lobos

images.prompt: Two glasses of drink and a plate of snacks on a boat seat, with the orange and pink sky of a Madeira sunset over the Atlantic and the Funchal coast in the distance.
images.alt: Drinks and snacks aboard a boat at sunset off Madeira
